Programmes
Bachelor programmes
Ghent University offers a limited number of bachelor programmes taught entirely in English. Currently, four programmes are available:
Three are offered at Ghent University Global Campus (GUGC) in South Korea:
Bachelor of Science in Environmental Technology
Bachelor of Science in Food Technology
Bachelor of Science in Molecular Biotechnology
In addition, the Bachelor of Social Sciences is taught entirely in English, with application and enrolment managed by VUB.
An overview of all programmes is available in our course catalogue.

Postgraduate studies
Study and learning paths intended to enable you to explore the competences acquired upon completion of a bachelor's or master's study, in greater depth and scope, as part of your further professional training.
An overview of all programmes is published in our course catalogue.
PhD studies
There are two possibilities to start a PhD at Ghent University: apply for an open PhD position or approach a specific Ghent University professor.
More information
Short courses specifically for PhD students can be found on the webpage of the Doctoral Schools.

The various Academies for Lifelong Learning at Ghent University offer their courses through the Nova Academy. Summer courses open to participants from the professional field are organized at the Nova Academy.
